message.content:
It depends on the format of the game you’re playing.  
In a standard Texas Hold’em hand each player receives only two private cards, so the maximum number of hearts a single player can hold is **two**.  
In other poker variants (e.g., Five‑Card Draw, Seven‑Card Stud, etc.) the hand size is larger, so a player could hold up to five or seven hearts, respectively.

If you’d like me to simulate a specific game and tell you which player ends up with the most hearts, just let me know:

- Number of players  
- Cards dealt per player (or the game type, e.g., “Texas Hold’em”, “Five‑Card Draw”)  

I can then run a quick deal and report the results.
